latex-workshop.latex.tools.name: copy-pdf-to-root
args: $doc='%DOC%'; $root=Split-Path -Path $doc -Parent; $name=Split-Path -Path $doc -Leaf; $src=Join-Path (Join-Path $root 'build') ($name + '.pdf'); $dest=Join-Path $root ($name + '.pdf'); if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $src)) { Write-Error "PDF not found: $src"; exit 1 }; $ok=$false; for ($i=0; $i -lt 10; $i++) { try { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination $dest -Force -ErrorAction Stop; $ok=$true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250 } }; if (-not $ok) { Write-Error "Unable to overwrite $dest because it is locked by another process. Close external PDF viewers and rebuild."; exit 1 }; exit 0
